submitted.rationale: Five EQE measurements covered the Cr-Sb-O line at Sb fractions 0.18, 0.32, 0.49, 0.62 and 0.79. Every response is close to zero under 2.1 eV illumination. Index 23 (Sb 0.79) gave the highest EQE at 0.0059%. The low-Sb side and the CrSbO4 composition (Sb about 0.5) came out lower or negative.
